comments.author: @NICEGLOBE05
comments.text: Framing Mexican street food as just 'cheap' overlooks why it’s recognized by UNESCO as Intangible Cultural Heritage! It’s not about low prices; it’s about convivialidad—the community warmth and centuries-old culinary mastery behind every puesto. From indigenous corn nixtamalization to vibrant family recipes passed down through generations, Mexico’s food culture has a soul like nowhere else. Brilliant documentary!
